subject: mth
title: MTH.------EXT.F.
description: Diagram in MID-W-29, just before the West Coast subsection. (C)MTH (the concept of methodology) is crossed with EXT-FT (extended functionalism). The diagram poses how methodology — as a concept in development — is structurally linked with extended functionalism. AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) branches from the main line and opens into INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branches from the main line and opens into TRS (transition). ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) branches from the main line and opens into AF-POST (affinity postulation) → VT-S (vibrational science), which opens into RE-ST (restructuralism) and LANG-DY (language dynamics) → MTA-IMP (meta-implications).
